title: Static Turn-End Luggage Reclaim Corner
description: One static baggage reclaim-corner scene for the original luggage pickup-area program. A complete existing radial quarter-turn roller section stands on the right with its near terminal mouth facing a generous empty approach. A complete slotted side guide stands separately behind the left staging bay, using an exact whole-instance signed-permutation quarter-turn. In front-left a complete arched luggage trolley carries one complete fixed-open deep travel case: both whole skid soles lie within the actual unchanged trolley platform polygon, while all other trolley components remain separate. Four complete old models, unit scale, original raw GLB buffers, internal nodes and per-face PBR preserved. Only one connected apron with low boundary is new scene-only geometry. Unlike the acceptance counter and the loaded three-mouth Y sorting layout, this is a terminal-approach and cart-loading arrangement with no counter, scale, Y junction, scanner or cage. The complete open case is static, not animated or portrayed as moving across rollers. The curved module and guide are deliberately separated and not claimed compatible or connected; no carousel or automatic luggage transfer is implied. One scene, zero new independent models. No conveying operation, throughput, luggage safety, working module connection, airport procedure, handle or wheel motion, certified walkway width or engineering performance is claimed.
